items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: Sonny. They shared a room together. And they were good buddies but I guess they both got to drinking.

ctx.x: Sonny. They shared a room together. And they were good buddies but I guess they both got to drinking. And they got into an argument over something. And he said they just tore up the room. They beat each other up. And the two of them got up the next morning and they had to go make the gig. So I mean the music overrides.

Yeah. Musicians are people too you know, but they had their foibles. It’s funny, the difference that Sonny Payne made in that band, like when you did that thing with your arms. I remember Joe Williams talking about that, that he really lit a fire under that group. Okay I was going to try one more thing for you here.
